FORM/0 — round 3

mirroring root-caused · transparent previews · crisp HUD · thread pan + pinch

Reported bugs

X-flipped posts and their buttons

The flat scenes viewed their card quads from +Z. Babylon is left-handed, so screen-right was world -X: every CreatePlane card was seen from behind — mirrored posters, mirrored reply badges, and even a reversed column order. All flat scenes now use core/gfx.flatCamera() (ortho at -Z) and no texture kind needs any flip; the per-GPU boot calibration is deleted. Separately, dominantFacing() was putting the poster camera behind flat models, and the viewer's orbit started on the back side — both fixed and measured on live feed content.

3D previews had black backgrounds

Two independent bugs: makeCardMaterial called mat.needAlphaBlending() (a getter) instead of passing needAlphaBlending: true as a ShaderMaterial option, so cards drew opaque; and the poster/preview scenes ran with autoClear = false, so rtt.clearColor never applied (the scene owns the clear on the camera.outputRenderTarget path). Now they clear to (0,0,0,0) and composite over the backdrop.

Blurry buttons and symbols

Every HUD glyph (⤨ ⏃ ⤓ ↩ …) is missing from the default UI fonts and fell back to a blurry substitute face. All icons are now inline stroked SVG; the reply badge draws its arrow with canvas vector strokes; the engine renders at devicePixelRatio (capped at 2) instead of a pinned 1.0/1.25.

Thread pan moved constantly, no pinch

Pan measured the delta from the pointer-down anchor on every move and added it to the pan, so the map accelerated away while held. It now integrates the per-event delta. Input moved to native canvas pointer events (Babylon funnels touches through navigator.maxTouchPoints slots and drops the second finger) → pinch zoom, two-finger pan, wheel zoom about the cursor, 0 re-fits.
